claim: Sep-2026 figures corroborated independently of the parse
detail: Reports standalone PAT Rs 19,509.96 cr (+4.7% YoY, from Rs 18,641.28 cr), NII Rs 34,619.18 cr (from Rs 31,551.50 cr), GNPA 1.11%, NNPA 0.37% for Q2 FY27; NIM 3.16% on total assets. The year-ago base figures also match the panel's Sep-2025 row (PAT Rs 18,641 cr; NII Rs 31,552 cr to the crore). Note: some early wire copy put PAT at Rs 19,610 cr; the filing-based reports (PTI, Reuters, and Mint's own text) put standalone PAT at Rs 19,509.96 cr, and that is the figure checked here.
source: Mint -- 'HDFC Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 5% to Rs 19,510 crore, NII jumps 10% in last quarter under outgoing CEO Jagdishan'

claim: Absolute bad-loan stocks: gross NPA stock flat sequentially, net NPA stock falling
detail: Filing figures: GNPA Rs 35,809.70 cr at Sep-2026 (Rs 35,846 cr at Jun-2026; Rs 34,289.48 cr a year earlier), NNPA Rs 11,850.86 cr (Rs 12,357 cr at Jun-2026; Rs 11,447.29 cr a year earlier). Coverage implied by these absolutes = (35,809.70-11,850.86)/35,809.70 = 66.9%. Total income Rs 97,257.62 cr; gross advances Rs 32,19,500 cr (+16.3% YoY).
source: PTI via Mid-Day -- 'HDFC Bank Q2FY27 net profit rises 4.7 per cent to Rs 19,509.96 crore' (from the bank's regulatory filing)

claim: Provisioning context: provisions up year-on-year; PAT below consensus as treasury gains fell
detail: Provisions and contingencies Rs 3,573.62 cr in Q2 FY27 vs Rs 3,501 cr a year earlier; total credit cost ratio 0.44%. PAT of Rs 19,510 cr came in below the Bloomberg consensus estimate of Rs 19,606 cr as treasury trading gains fell to Rs 780 cr from Rs 2,390 cr a year earlier; excluding treasury gains, bottom-line growth was 12.6% YoY. NIM 3.16% on total assets; CAR 18.9% and CET-1 17.1% at 30 Sep 2026.
source: Business Today -- 'HDFC Bank Q2 results: Net profit rises 4.7% to Rs 19,510 crore; key highlights'
